title: Filter Bar
description: A shared list filtering block that combines search, scoped filters, and optional actions ahead of result content.

slots.name: search-input
slots.description: A compact search field for narrowing the current result set.

slots.name: filter-groups
slots.description: The canonical filter controls for status, owner, date, or other scoped facets.

slots.name: result-summary
slots.description: A lightweight summary of the active filter state or result count.

slots.name: primary-action
slots.description: An optional action such as create, export, or save view.

slots.name: secondary-actions
slots.description: Secondary actions like clear all, reset, or saved filters.

doNotUseWhen: The page only needs a single standalone search field without scoped filters.
The flow requires mobile-only sheet presentation or platform-specific navigation chrome.
